notes: Added missing coverage for schema contract, API exposure, testing, and integration validation for explainability layer.

stories.title: Explainability Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define a strict Pydantic schema for explainability objects including fields for source, meaning, limitations, and optional metadata (confidence, link). Ensure compatibility with existing tool_models patterns.

stories.title: Explainability Injection into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to attach explainability objects to all evaluation responses (provider + trials), ensuring consistent structure is returned through the tool router.

stories.title: Explainability API Response Contract Validation
stories.description: Ensure FastAPI responses enforce the explainability schema and validate outputs before returning to frontend, preventing malformed or partial explainability structures.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Explainability Layer
stories.description: Create unit tests for normalization, fallback, and aggregation logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end explainability output from facade through API.

stories.title: End-to-End Explainability Rendering Validation
stories.description: Validate that explainability content flows correctly from backend through MessageBubble rendering, including markdown safety, link validation, and readable formatting in chat UI.
